## Personnel Zone Access and Alarm Response Procedures

Document: SOP-004 | Rev: 1.0 | Date: 2025-12-01 | Author: Ing. F. Ferrari - Safety & Compliance

## 1. Role-Zone Authorisation Matrix

| Role       | Prod. Area   | Server Room   | Gen. Warehouse   | Main Entrance   | Chem. Storage   | R&D Lab   | Cafeteria   |
|------------|--------------|---------------|------------------|-----------------|-----------------|-----------|-------------|
| operator   | YES          | NO            | YES              | YES             | NO              | NO        | YES         |
| technician | YES          | YES           | YES              | YES             | YES             | YES       | YES         |
| supervisor | YES          | YES           | YES              | YES             | YES             | YES       | YES         |
| manager    | YES          | YES           | YES              | YES             | YES             | YES       | YES         |
| security   | YES          | YES           | YES              | YES             | YES             | YES       | YES         |
| visitor    | YES          | NO            | NO               | YES             | NO              | NO        | YES         |

## 2. Maximum Occupancy per Zone

| Zone              |   Max Persons | Enforcement                                                   |
|-------------------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| Production Area   |            12 | WARNING above 10; CRITICAL above 12                           |
| Server Room       |             2 | CRITICAL above 2; access badge required                       |
| General Warehouse |             4 | WARNING above 3                                               |
| Main Entrance     |             8 | Monitoring only                                               |
| Chemical Storage  |             4 | CRITICAL above 4; hazmat training required -see RULE-CHM01-03 |
| R&D Lab           |             6 | WARNING above 5; precision experiments may be disturbed       |
| Cafeteria         |            20 | Monitoring only -occupant comfort                             |

## 3. Maximum Acknowledgment Times by Role and Severity

| Role       |   Max Ack -WARNING (min) |   Max Ack -CRITICAL (min) |
|------------|--------------------------|---------------------------|
| operator   |                       15 |                         3 |
| technician |                       10 |                         2 |
| supervisor |                        5 |                         1 |
| manager    |                       15 |                         5 |
| security   |                       20 |                         5 |

## 4. Unauthorised Access Rules

RULE-ACCESS-01: Any entry by an unauthorised role MUST be logged as OccupancyEvent::UnauthorisedAccess with person_id, zone, and timestamp.

RULE-ACCESS-02: Security personnel MUST be notified within 2 minutes of detection.

RULE-ACCESS-03: The KG node MUST include authorized=NO and a reference to this rule. RULE-ACCESS-04: Chemical Storage has zero-tolerance policy. Any UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS triggers immediate escalation to the Safety Officer regardless of role.
